style: Original Claude Monet-inspired pond studies; not reproductions or works attributed to Monet.
purpose: Theme-specific brushwork for the compact interactive maze

items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: painted texture for a small interactive maze on a minimalist personal website. Primary request: an original Claude Monet-inspired impressionist water-lily pond study, seen straight down, with authentic broken oil-paint brushwork, visible dabs and layered scumbles. Horizontal 5:3 composition, the pond fills the entire canvas, no horizon, no frame. Small lily pads and loose reflected foliage distributed across the image, plenty of quiet water. This will be used as a texture inside code-drawn maze banks, so avoid large focal objects. No maze, no interface, no text, no letters, no watermark, no people or animals. Painterly, hand-made, subtle and elegant, not a smooth digital gradient, not vector art. Light-mode variant: misty morning light, celadon green, sage, powder blue, soft lavender, tiny dusty-rose blossom flecks. A light-to-mid value painting with delicate but visible brushwork.
